finding.description: Configuration and database backups are downloadable.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: directory-listing-backups (Configuration and database backups are downloadable. Evidence: index listing wp-config.php.bak and shop-2024-03-01.sql). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Recommended fix: configure web server to not automatically list contents of directories with no index page present, and remove backup source files not intended to be accessible from the web-accessible directory.

sources.contribution: Web servers can be configured to automatically list the contents of directories that do not have an index page present - disable automatic listing
Directory listing may reveal backup source files which can be accessed to read sensitive information - remove backup source files from web root
listing points straight at backup and temporary files (.bak) - remove .bak files from browsable folders

verification.detail: Attackers read listings to find backup files, configuration files, source code and documentation that were not meant to be public.

fix.summary: Disable backup directory listing and backup file downloads by serving the normal catalogue shop page with 404 instead.
fix.risk: Backup URLs now return catalogue page 404; no journey uses them so shop flows unchanged.
